DBSCAN.eps_rule: fit-only q quantile (linear interpolation) of Euclidean mth-neighbor distance, explicitly including self in count
DBSCAN.score: minimum Euclidean distance from query to frozen fit-set DBSCAN core samples divided by eps
DBSCAN.diagnostic_rule: score > 1 (outside all fixed core epsilon balls); not native DBSCAN predict; reported separately from selection-F1 threshold

resources.policy: resource limit aborts entire pilot; candidates are not silently dropped for memory; undefined/no-convergence candidates are logged and cause REVIEW_REQUIRED_CANDIDATES

transparency: DBSCAN out-of-sample scoring is an explicit core-distance extension, not a native predict API.
